production.title: Production
production.text1: Having started its sector activities in 1997, our company is currently Turkey's largest bulb manufacturing facility with an annual production capacity of 60 million units. In our 22,000m² closed area, with 200 employees and full automation, we produce LED bulbs, filament rustic bulbs, surface and flush-mounted LED panels and spots, LED projectors, LED waterproof fixtures, LED street luminaires, LED wall washers, pendant chandeliers, LED store spots, and decorative linear fixtures.
production.text2: Commanding a significant market share, Kendal Elektrik closely follows global technological developments and is the first to implement them in Turkey. Notably, we were the first to manufacture filament rustic bulbs in Turkey. While K2 is our company's own brand, we also manufacture proprietary brands for numerous companies in Turkey and abroad.
production.text3: Continuously making high investments in ERP software every year, Kendal Elektrik monitors all its production online and reports live using the MES/MAS program.

hr_policy.vision_text: To create a qualified workforce that is highly motivated, protects and elevates the corporate image, prioritizes innovative work, values service, and views their job as part of a cohesive whole.
hr_policy.mission_text: To plan the human resources needed to achieve our company's goals and strategies, train our personnel, perform personnel operations at the highest level, and maintain highly self-confident staff who are experts in their fields, capable of representing the company, and generating new initiatives.
hr_policy.policy_text: Kendal Elektrik's core human resources policy is to operate in adherence to the principles of efficiency and profitability within the framework of relevant legislation and established policies. By developing its contemporary and innovative corporate structure, Kendal Elektrik has adopted the strategic goal of having employees who are experts in their fields and capable of introducing new perspectives.
hr_policy.training_text: In order to have employees who are experts in their fields and capable of creating new opportunities, and to increase competence and prepare them for higher roles, we organize in-service trainings in accordance with the principles of efficiency, effectiveness, and economy. Through our Personnel Performance Management System, we aim to integrate personal goals with organizational objectives, support personal success, increase corporate success, evaluate the contributions of all employees towards corporate goals through a fair, systematic, and measurable method, determine employee expectations to increase their loyalty, and create a motivating work environment to boost workforce productivity.
hr_policy.health_safety_text: At Kendal Elektrik, occupational health and safety is adopted as a natural part of work life and corporate culture, and the continuous improvement of this culture is targeted. Occupational health and safety practices are implemented in accordance with relevant legislation, obligations, and standards, while the best practices in this field are constantly followed and adapted. In all activities, potential risks are analyzed in advance, and proactive approaches are put forward to prevent these risks. Refresher trainings on occupational health and safety are provided to all employees upon hiring and periodically during their employment.

principles: Determining the qualifications of personnel appropriate for the specific role and executing the appointment processes.
Identifying the necessary training to develop the personnel's work ability, success, and effort, and ensuring they receive it.
Encouraging personnel to work in adherence to ethical behavior principles and efficiency/profitability principles, and fostering corporate loyalty.
Informing personnel in a timely manner about matters that concern them.
Continuously reviewing, updating, and developing the Human Resources policy.
Adopting, participating in, and encouraging the concept and projects of Social Responsibility in all practices.
Further strengthening our Respectful and Eco-Friendly employee profile.
human_rights: As Kendal Elektrik, we consider it a fundamental responsibility to respect human rights, protect universal values, and raise awareness on this issue in all our activities.
We commit to non-discrimination in our relations with employees and customers in line with Kendal Elektrik's Ethical Principles.
Our management has the responsibility to prevent mistreatment, discrimination, or harassment in the workplace and to report such situations immediately to Human Resources.
Providing an open and reliable communication environment where complaints can be communicated without fear of retaliation is our top priority.
We adopt the principle of not establishing business relationships with any institution or organization that violates national and international labor laws, especially child labor.

Through our voluntary participation in the "Workplace Equality Declaration" (İşte Eşitlik Bildirgesi) conducted in collaboration with the Republic of Turkey Ministry of Family and Social Services and the World Economic Forum, we support gender equality and offer equal opportunities based on merit in recruitment and career development. Additionally, we actively support the return of working mothers to business life.

Our employment policy complying with the Labor Law No. 4857, our respect for unionization and collective bargaining rights, our occupational health and safety trainings, and our definitive stance against forced labor are standards we never compromise on, both within our organization and among our business partners.

production_page.title: Production
content: Kendal Elektrik, in its modern production facility with a closed area of 22,000 m² which became operational in 2017, is among the leading manufacturers of the sector with an annual production capacity of 80 million lighting products. In the production infrastructure supported by high automation technology, LED bulbs, LED panels, filament LED bulbs, candle bulbs, manual assembly lines, SMD assembly systems, and plastic injection production are carried out under a single roof.

As the only manufacturer producing filament LED bulbs in Turkey, Europe, and the Middle East, Kendal Elektrik bases every stage of production on international quality standards. While all raw materials and semi-finished products coming from suppliers go through IQC (Incoming Quality Control) processes, IPQC (In Process Quality Control) is applied throughout the production, and the final products are inspected again with OQC (Outgoing Quality Control) before shipment.

Thanks to the production processes carried out in ESD-protected production areas, electronic components are protected against electrostatic discharge, while the products undergo comprehensive quality controls such as electrical safety, mechanical endurance, photometric performance, power consumption, power factor, EMC compliance, driver control, lumen value, color temperature, CRI measurement, insulation resistance, grounding resistance, high voltage, leakage current, aging, lifetime, and drop tests. Supporting digital production management with ERP, MES, and WMS systems, Kendal Elektrik safely delivers innovative lighting solutions produced in Turkey to many countries of the world with its high production capacity, advanced automation infrastructure, traceable processes, and sustainable quality understanding.

k2.title: About K2
k2.description: Taking its name from K2, one of the most challenging and prestigious mountains for climbers to summit, our brand operates with the vision of being the 'Peak of Lighting'. Representing Kendal Elektrik's comprehensive range of professional LED lighting systems and energy-efficient solutions, K2 delivers top-tier quality and durability for industrial and architectural needs, even under the most demanding conditions.

vanti.title: About Vanti
vanti.description: Vanti is Kendal Elektrik's specialized brand for ventilation, climate control, and modern lifestyle solutions. Featuring an extensive lineup of ceiling fans with smart LED lighting, industrial standing fans, wall-mounted fans, and portable solutions, Vanti combines powerful airflow with innovative features like voice control and remote operation to provide fresh and cool living spaces for homes, offices, and commercial environments.
